subject: Re: Model regression after v2.3.1 update — next steps and pin request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rios <alex.rios@retailco.com>
Cc: Natalie Cho <natalie.cho@retailco.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Sales discovery recap & recommended model + follow-ups

Hi Alex / Natalie — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from today's discovery call and proposed next steps: 

Key takeaways:
- RetailCo needs a conversational summarization & product recommendation assistant across chat and email ingestion.
- Primary constraints: must match existing brand tone, <100ms median token latency for interactive sessions, and avoid hallucinations on product specs.
- Volume profile: peak 6k reqs/hr, median session length ~120 tokens.

Recommended fit:
- Suggest starting with redwood/gpt-3.5-mix-optimized (quantized) for production pilot — good balance of latency + quality on retail dialogue benchmarks.
- For higher-fidelity product spec answers, recommend redwood/gpt-4lite for tiered routing when product-resolution is required.

Action items (we'll own items 1–3):
1) Share benchmark artifacts + prompt set we used for RetailCo mock eval (attached: prompt_set_retailco_v1.txt).
2) Run a fast eval with your sample logs — you mentioned sending 200 chat sessions.
3) If results look good, propose a 2-week canary on your staging environment pinned to gpt-3.5-mix-optimized followed by production rollout.

Also flagged: our platform released model runtime update v2.3.1 last week which changed kernel scheduling for some quantized profiles — we haven't seen broad regressions but will monitor closely. If you notice issues, we'll prioritize a pin or rollback.

Attachments: prompt_set_retailco_v1.txt

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Rios <alex.rios@retailco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Natalie Cho <natalie.cho@retailco.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sales discovery recap & recommended model + follow-ups

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap. Quick update after kicking the pilot on staging:

- We ran the 200-session sample through the suggested prompt set. Overall summaries look fine, but about ~12% of responses after the v2.3.1 runtime update are returning outdated product specs (e.g., old SKU mappings) and occasionally hallucinated pricing. We did the same sample against the previous pinned runtime (v2.2.8) and saw ~3% problematic responses.
- Attached is a diff CSV with a few flagged examples and the request/response pairs (retailco_eval_v2.3.1-diffs.csv).

This is blocking our decision to go to canary in prod — we need to understand whether this is a prompt/regression issue or something with the kernel selection in v2.3.1. Can we escalate?

Alex
Director, Product Innovation | RetailCo
alex.rios@retailco.com

Can SE/infra triage:

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Regression observed on v2.3.1 — request for pin/rollback + next steps

Thanks — dug into the diffs. Preliminary notes: 
- Reproduced 18/20 flagged samples locally. The differences correlate with changed attention kernel scheduling for 8-bit quantized paths in v2.3.1.
- Hypothesis: some prefix caching + kernel path selection for short-context sessions changed token probabilities for rare SKU tokens. Not a prompt issue per se.

Recommended immediate plan (quick playbook):
1) Pin RetailCo staging to runtime v2.2.8 for the next 48 hours (no model version change, runtime-only pin). This is low-risk and reversible.
2) Run expanded evaluation (2k sessions) across both runtimes and generate a diff report (we'll feed a targeted hallucination metric).
3) Engineering to prepare a patch to restore previous kernel selection for the affected quantized path if confirmed (ETA 3–5 business days).
4) Canary in prod: staggered rollout pinned to v2.2.8 then flip to v2.3.1 in sandboxed traffic slices once metrics match.

Monica — can you draft the monitoring checks (latency, hallucination-rate, token-coverage) and the rollback steps for the canary plan? I'll coordinate infra pins and grant RetailCo temporary access to the staging pin toggle.

Rishi
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Regression observed on v2.3.1 — next steps and pin request

Alex / Natalie — thanks for the quick reproduction and sample diffs. Short summary + next steps we will execute immediately: 

1) Pin staging runtime to v2.2.8 (no model changes) — effective now for your staging org. We will share confirmation when toggle is applied.
2) Run the expanded evaluation (Rishi & infra) and deliver a diff report by EOD tomorrow.
3) Monica will share the canary monitoring/rollback plan (attached: canary_plan_v1.md) with checks for hallucination-rate thresholds, latency SLOs, and automated rollback hooks.
4) If the 2k-sample eval confirms a regression tied to v2.3.1 kernel selection, engineering will prioritize a targeted patch (3–5 business days) or we can keep RetailCo pinned until patch is validated.

Please confirm you're okay with staging pin for the next 48 hours and we'll schedule a 30-minute follow-up for Thursday to review the diff report.

Thanks,
Marissa

marissa@redwood.ai
